clue.text: Name of person out of favour, even in area regularly covered

parts.words: Name of person out of favour
parts.note: someone in disgrace is said to have a name that is mud
even ground is flat

explanation.surface: A disgraced person's name turns up, oddly, in a place that gets covered at regular intervals.
explanation.walkthrough: 'His name is mud' is an idiom for someone in disgrace. The definition refers to land the tide floods twice a day.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal flat of silt that the sea floods and uncovers with each tide.

clue.text: Workers accepting benefit, bowled over

indicators.note: the workers take in the benefit, so one word is placed inside the other

parts.note: workers are men in crossword shorthand
aid is help or benefit

explanation.surface: Workers taking a handout are knocked flat.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a sequence of six balls without a run scored off them is known by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket, an over in which no runs are scored is called by this name.

clue.text: In depressing situation, one's son gets the push

indicators.note: in places the next pieces inside the gloomy word

parts.note: the dismals is an old name for a depressing state of affairs
one's is I's, the letters I and S
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son

explanation.surface: Things are grim: someone's boy has been sacked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'depressing situation' stands for the old noun 'the dismals', a fit of gloom; 'one's' is read as I'S.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting the push is colloquial for being sacked from a job.

clue.text: Back pain causing head of production to leave plant

indicators.note: the initial letter departs from the plant name, so it is removed

parts.note: plumbago is a flowering shrub, also called leadwort

indicators.note: head of signals the opening letter of the following word

explanation.surface: Back trouble forces a production manager to quit the factory.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks like a factory, but it is a botanical plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A common term for pain in the lower part of the spine.

clue.text: One may be let down by some deliverymen

definitions.text: One may be let down by some deliverymen

parts.words: One may be let down by some deliverymen
parts.note: delivery drivers lower the hinged rear flap of their lorry to unload goods

explanation.surface: A person may be disappointed by unreliable couriers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'let down' suggests disappointment, but it means lowered.
explanation.definitionFit: The hinged board at the back of a lorry or cart that is lowered for loading.

clue.text: Outburst from passenger going across lake to city

indicators.note: the passenger word straddles the lake letter, so it is placed around it

parts.note: a fare is a paying passenger in a taxi
L is the standard abbreviation for lake on maps
one goes up to London or a university city, so up means to the city

explanation.surface: A taxi rider crossing a lake on the way into town has an outburst.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going across' puts L inside FARE to give FLARE. In British usage you travel 'up' to London, whichever direction you're coming from.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden burst of anger or violence is a synonym for this hyphenated word.

clue.text: Situated at centre of overthrown state

indicators.note: overthrown means turned upside down, so the word of is read in reverse

parts.note: Cal is an abbreviation for California, a US state

explanation.surface: Positioned in the middle of a toppled regime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overthrown' turns OF into FO.
explanation.definitionFit: Placed at the central point or focus is a sense of this adjective.

clue.text: Chemist capable of breaking down any salt

indicators.note: breaking down suggests the letters are taken apart and reassembled

explanation.surface: A chemist who can decompose any salt.
explanation.walkthrough: 'breaking down' rearranges ANYSALT.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemist who determines the composition of substances is one type of scientist doing this work.

clue.text: She inspires poetry some wonder at often

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: The muse of verse is someone we often marvel at.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth, the Muse of lyric and love poetry.

clue.text: Standing outside shelter, farm animal beginning to eat

indicators.note: the farm animal wraps around the shelter word

parts.note: a pig is a farm animal
a rest is a shelter, as in a rest for travellers

indicators.note: beginning to points to the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: Standing outside a shed, a farm animal starts eating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standing' looks like part of the picture of the animal by the shed, but it is the definition, meaning status.
explanation.definitionFit: Social standing means high status or reputation.

clue.text: Sheep may be counted as one of his resources

definitions.text: Sheep may be counted as one of his resources

parts.words: Sheep may be counted as one of his resources
parts.note: counting sheep is the traditional remedy tried by someone who cannot get to sleep, so it is one of his resources

explanation.surface: A farmer lists his sheep among the assets he owns.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who suffers from sleeplessness may try counting sheep to drop off.

clue.text: Live with a wife that's sensible

parts.note: W is the abbreviation for wife in genealogies
to live is to be, and are is a form of be

explanation.surface: Living with a wife who has good sense.
explanation.definitionFit: Sensible in the old sense of conscious of something, as in being sensible of a danger.

clue.text: Girl in the morning leaving the country

indicators.note: the morning abbreviation departs from the country, so its letters are removed

parts.note: America is commonly called simply the country
AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: A young woman emigrates from her homeland one morning.
explanation.walkthrough: Removing AM from AMERICA leaves the girl's name.
explanation.definitionFit: A female first name, so it fits a girl.

clue.text: Animal with 'horns can attack vigorously

parts.note: a billy or billycan is a metal can for cooking over a campfire
to go at something is to attack it vigorously

explanation.surface: A horned animal is capable of charging fiercely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'can' looks like a verb but is the noun billycan; 'go at' is read as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The male of the goat species carries horns, so it is a horned animal.

clue.text: Act ruthlessly, as those launching rocket do?

explanation.surface: Behaving without scruple, like the team counting down at a launch site.
explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the idiom literally: a countdown ends when it reaches zero.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to be prepared to do anything at all, however unscrupulous, to reach a goal.

clue.text: New coinage — euro, for example

explanation.surface: The euro was a new currency introduced to replace old money.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coinage' suggests money, but the definition means a newly coined word; the euro was both.
explanation.definitionFit: A newly invented word or expression is called by this term.

clue.text: Dreadful realities for Jacob's descendant

indicators.note: dreadful hints that the letters of the word are badly mangled

explanation.surface: A descendant of Jacob faces dreadful truths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dreadful' rearranges REALITIES. Jacob was also called Israel in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: Jacob was renamed Israel, so his descendants are the ancient Hebrew people.

clue.text: The workers here could make a packet

definitions.text: The workers here could make a packet

parts.words: The workers here could make a packet
parts.note: a packet is also a mail boat, so the place where workers build one is a boatbuilding yard

explanation.surface: The staff at this place could earn a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make a packet' suggests earning lots of money, but a packet is a packet boat.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where vessels are built and repaired, including packet boats.

clue.text: Two things for motorist to steer round — or 20

definitions.text: Two things for motorist to steer round

explanation.surface: A driver must avoid a pothole and a bend, or something hidden.
explanation.walkthrough: The first definition reads the phrase literally as two road hazards; '20' refers to the answer of 20-down, meaning secret.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase describes furtive, clandestine dealings, just as a road hazard list names a pit and a bend.

clue.text: Declares a business concern's sound

indicators.note: sound tells us the phrase is spoken and heard as a single word

parts.note: a firm is a business concern, so a firm's said aloud

explanation.surface: A company declares itself sound.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like healthy, but signals the homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: To affirm is to state firmly or assert something.

clue.text: Pull machine up — he's too close

indicators.note: in a down clue up means the pieces are read from bottom to top

parts.note: to drag is to pull
a gin is a machine, as in a cotton gin

explanation.surface: Haul the engine up — he is standing too near.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' reverses DRAG and GIN together. 'Close' is the British sense of mean with money.
explanation.definitionFit: A miser is mean or stingy, which is what close means here.

clue.text: Church office's put up under wraps

indicators.note: in a down clue put up means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: terce is the canonical office for the third hour of the day, plus the s

explanation.surface: A church office has been raised but kept under wraps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put up' reverses TERCES. Terce is a service of daily prayer in the Christian liturgy.
explanation.definitionFit: Something under wraps is hidden from view, kept private.

clue.text: Opt for oil distribution as minister's responsibility

indicators.note: distribution suggests the letters of these words are shared out in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Choosing to hand out oil is the minister's job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distribution' rearranges OPTFOROIL.
explanation.definitionFit: A government minister holds a department or area of responsibility, such as defence or health.

clue.text: Hood gettin' ready for court, as does judge?

definitions.text: gettin' ready for court, as does judge?

explanation.surface: Hood is getting dressed in robes before court, just like a judge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gettin'' drops the final G, so robing for court becomes the outlaw's first name.
explanation.definitionFit: Robin Hood is the legendary English outlaw; a judge is robing before going into court.

clue.text: Exert pressure through highly effective shot at first

indicators.note: at first says the shot comes before the other piece

parts.note: a lob is a high shot in tennis that can be effective
by means through, as in by means of

explanation.surface: Push your case by playing a powerful high shot first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'highly' points to the lob's high arc over an opponent; 'at first' fixes the order of the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To lobby is to try to influence politicians or officials.

clue.text: Delight when bishop enters church land

indicators.note: the bishop letter goes into the word for delight

parts.note: delight means glee
B is the chess notation abbreviation for bishop

explanation.surface: There is joy when the bishop walks into the church grounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'enters' puts B inside GLEE.
explanation.definitionFit: Historically, a parcel of land assigned to a parish priest as part of his living.

clue.text: We see red after such a warning

definitions.text: We see red after such a warning

parts.words: We see red after such a warning
parts.note: at British traffic lights the caution light comes on just before the stop light, so a driver sees red after it

explanation.surface: We lose our temper once given this kind of warning.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see red' looks like getting angry, but it describes traffic lights.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellowish caution light that precedes the stop signal on traffic lights.

clue.text: Gerard, for example, taking new bride round European capital

indicators.note: the rearranged bride letters go round the capital city
new tells us the letters of the word bride are made into a new order

parts.note: Riga is the capital of Latvia

explanation.surface: A man named Gerard takes his new wife round a European city.
explanation.walkthrough: Brigadier Gerard is Arthur Conan Doyle's dashing Napoleonic cavalry officer; 'new' is the anagram signal and 'round' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Brigadier Gerard is a fictional army officer, so Gerard is an example of that military rank.

clue.text: Hardy characters belonged to such a line

definitions.text: Hardy characters belonged to such a line

parts.words: Hardy characters belonged to such a line
parts.note: Thomas Hardy's verse drama The Dynasts is about ruling figures of the Napoleonic era, who belonged to hereditary ruling lines

explanation.surface: Thomas Hardy's characters belong to some family tree.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hardy characters' suggests tough letters, but it means figures in Thomas Hardy's epic drama The Dynasts.
explanation.definitionFit: A succession of rulers from one family, such as the Habsburg or Bourbon lines.

clue.text: Fresh dew shrouded in thin fog in the Ohio area

indicators.note: the reworked letters are wrapped inside the word for thin fog

parts.note: mist is a thin fog

indicators.note: fresh suggests the letters of dew are made over anew

explanation.surface: Fresh dew lies under a light fog across the Ohio landscape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fresh' sits naturally beside its noun in the surface, which hides its job as the anagram signal; 'shrouded in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: The region of the north-central United States that includes Ohio, Illinois and Indiana.
